resource.name: email-notifications-service
resource.description: Sends templated notification email on the product's behalf: an engagement raised, updated, approved or cancelled, and an allocation's clearance notices.
resource.provider: the organization's email notifications service, a template-based relay in front of the mail system

config.description: The identifier the service knows the calling app by, sent in every request
Client id for the client-credentials grant
Client secret for the client-credentials grant
Token address for the client-credentials grant

resource.consumptionInstructions: Authenticate with OAuth2 client credentials against the token address and send the bearer token. One operation: `POST /send-smtp-email` with `{ appUuid, to: [<address>], cc: [<address>], frm, subject, templateId, contentKeyValPairs: { <placeholder>: <text> } }`. The service rejects an empty `to` list, so resolve recipients first and skip the send when none remain. Templates live on the service side and are addressed by id; the ids the product uses are agreed with the service's owners (the current app uses one per notice kind, such as a customer engagement, an internal engagement and a marketing event). The product reads nothing from the response. The service fronts the organization's mail system; callers never send mail directly.
